blurb:
See Niagara Falls from 3 spectacular angles with a professional guide who captures every single memory! This premium 3-hour tour includes panoramic views from Skylon Tower (Top), the thrilling Journey Behind the Falls (Behind), and the iconic Niagara City Cruise boat ride (Above).

After enjoying the exhilarating cruise, we will head to the beautiful Oakes Garden Theatre. There, amidst stunning landscapes, your guide will conduct a complimentary professional digital photo session to wrap up your experience. Perfect for travelers looking for the ultimate sights, skipped lines, and picture-perfect memories!

3-hour guided tour showcasing Niagara's top attractions

Visit Skylon Tower for panoramic views (Top Angle)

Experience Journey Behind the Falls from Table Rock (Behind Angle)

Enjoy the exhilarating Niagara City Cruise boat ride (Above Angle)
